data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.headline: Colonials Reclaim Dead Lands Ruin; Weathered Expanse Blazes On
previous_model_summary.war_summary: The chief change since our last edition stands in the Dead Lands, where the demolished work beside Callahan's Boot has passed back into Colonial hands, leaving the wreck in Godcrofts the only ruin on the board. The Dead Lands remains the costliest field — some 20,500 casualties in a day, the Warden share the heavier — while Weathered Expanse burns on with twenty-three actions in the same span, six in the past two hours, most at Spirit Watch, and the losses there running nearly even. In Stonecradle the grind about The Long Fast and The Cord goes on, fifteen events logged, one falling as this edition closed. Stlican Shelf, by contrast, has gone quiet: no actions in two hours, though the Wardens still hold seven of its nine works, The Pale House having seen eighteen blows in the day. Callahan's Passage shows no flag change in six hours, yet its casualty rate sharpens sharply; Linn of Mercy bleeds near 9,000 in a day without a single base action. The full board reads 261 works to the Colonials, 174 to the Wardens, one in ruin. It is the 167th day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
